title: Superficial Gluteal Stroking
summary: Broad palm strokes are applied over the muscular gluteal region with clear consent and appropriate draping.
goal: Gently include the gluteal muscles in the sequence.
startingPosition: The person lies face down; consent is obtained and only the necessary working area is exposed.
instructions: Make smooth passes over the muscular area.
direction: Broad movements over the muscular gluteal region.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
